fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Casts a line that deals 9 damage. Its damage rises +8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%). Each kill returns a charge, up to 3.

fusions.name: Quarry's Mark
fusions.desc: A long cast that deals 40 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, and strips 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Paid-Out Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Against enemies at low health, you deal 20% more damage.
